mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_search_session (search_session_id, account_id, user_id_hash, channel, started_at, last_activity_at) VALUES (#{search_session_id}, NULLIF(#{account_id}, ''), NULLIF(#{user_id_hash}, ''), #{channel}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_activity_at = NOW(), account_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(VALUES(account_id), ''), account_id), user_id_hash = COALESCE(NULLIF(VALUES(user_id_hash), ''), user_id_hash)

INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_search_event (search_session_id, account_id, query_raw, query_normalized, intent_type, result_count, filters_json, searched_at) VALUES (#{search_session_id}, NULLIF(#{account_id}, ''), #{query_raw}, #{query_normalized}, #{intent_type}, COALESCE(#{result_count}, 0), CAST(NULLIF(#{filters_json}, '') AS JSON), NOW())

INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_search_action (search_event_id, search_session_id, account_id, entity_type, entity_id, action_type, screen, position_no, context_json, occurred_at) VALUES (#{search_event_id}, #{search_session_id}, NULLIF(#{account_id}, ''), NULLIF(#{entity_type}, ''), NULLIF(#{entity_id}, ''), #{action_type}, NULLIF(#{screen}, ''), #{position_no}, CAST(NULLIF(#{context_json}, '') AS JSON), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT query_normalized AS query, COUNT(*) AS search_count, COUNT(DISTINCT search_session_id) AS session_count, MAX(searched_at) AS last_searched_at FROM the_full_order.tb_search_event WHERE searched_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND (NULLIF(#{account_id}, '') IS NULL OR account_id = #{account_id}) GROUP BY query_normalized ORDER BY search_count DESC, last_searched_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_searches, COUNT(DISTINCT search_session_id) AS total_sessions, SUM(CASE WHEN result_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_result_searches, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN result_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS result_rate FROM the_full_order.tb_search_event WHERE searched_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND (NULLIF(#{account_id}, '') IS NULL OR account_id = #{account_id})

SELECT query_normalized AS query, COUNT(*) AS search_count, MAX(searched_at) AS last_searched_at FROM the_full_order.tb_search_event WHERE result_count = 0 AND searched_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND (NULLIF(#{account_id}, '') IS NULL OR account_id = #{account_id}) GROUP BY query_normalized ORDER BY search_count DESC, last_searched_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT intent_type, COUNT(*) AS search_count FROM the_full_order.tb_search_event WHERE searched_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND (NULLIF(#{account_id}, '') IS NULL OR account_id = #{account_id}) GROUP BY intent_type ORDER BY search_count DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_recommendation_event (recommendation_id, search_session_id, account_id, user_id_hash, recommendation_type, request_context_json, model_version, generated_at) VALUES (#{recommendation_id}, NULLIF(#{search_session_id}, ''), NULLIF(#{account_id}, ''), NULLIF(#{user_id_hash}, ''), #{recommendation_type}, CAST(NULLIF(#{request_context_json}, '') AS JSON), #{model_version}, NOW())

INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_recommendation_item (recommendation_id, entity_type, entity_id, rank_no, score, reason_json) VALUES (#{recommendation_id}, #{entity_type}, #{entity_id}, #{rank_no}, #{score}, CAST(NULLIF(#{reason_json}, '') AS JSON))
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_recommendation_item SET accepted_yn = #{accepted_yn}, feedback_code = NULLIF(#{feedback_code}, ''), feedback_text = NULLIF(#{feedback_text}, ''), feedback_at = NOW() WHERE recommendation_id = #{recommendation_id} AND entity_type = #{entity_type} AND entity_id = #{entity_id}
mapper.select: SELECT guide_id, category, situation_code, title, risk_level, guidance_text, source_name, source_url, effective_from, effective_to FROM the_full_order.tb_hygiene_guide WHERE approved_yn = 'Y' AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE) AND (NULLIF(#{category}, '') IS NULL OR category = #{category}) AND (NULLIF(#{situation_code}, '') IS NULL OR situation_code = #{situation_code}) ORDER BY risk_level DESC, effective_from DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_hygiene_incident (incident_id, account_id, location_id, incident_type, measured_value, measurement_unit, situation_text, risk_level, status, occurred_at, user_id) VALUES (#{incident_id}, #{account_id}, NULLIF(#{location_id}, ''), #{incident_type}, #{measured_value}, NULLIF(#{measurement_unit}, ''), NULLIF(#{situation_text}, ''), NULLIF(#{risk_level}, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{status}, ''), 'OPEN'), COALESCE(#{occurred_at}, NOW()), NULLIF(#{user_id}, ''))

INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_hygiene_action (incident_id, guide_id, recommended_action, actual_action, completed_yn, confirmed_by, completed_at, user_id) VALUES (#{incident_id}, #{guide_id}, #{recommended_action}, NULLIF(#{actual_action}, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{completed_yn}, ''), 'N'), NULLIF(#{confirmed_by}, ''), CASE WHEN #{completed_yn} = 'Y' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, NULLIF(#{user_id}, ''))
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_hygiene_action SET actual_action = NULLIF(#{actual_action}, ''), completed_yn = #{completed_yn}, confirmed_by = NULLIF(#{confirmed_by}, ''), completed_at = CASE WHEN #{completed_yn} = 'Y' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE hygiene_action_id = #{hygiene_action_id}
